How Factorial scaled SDR productivity across 5 markets with Enginy
Factorial is an AI-powered business management platform that helps companies digitize core processes across time management, talent, finance, and IT.
As the company scaled rapidly across Europe, so did the pressure on its commercial teams to generate pipeline efficiently and consistently.
Enginy has literally changed the way we prospect.
Manual prospecting was killing productivity
Before Enginy, lead generation at Factorial was extremely resource-intensive.
For every six or seven SDRs, one full-time person was needed just to feed the pipeline. That person was generating around ten leads per day which wasn’t nearly enough to sustain growth.
As a result, SDRs were forced to prospect on their own however they could, pulling time away from conversations and follow-ups.
On top of that, data quality was a constant problem.
From manual effort to a real prospecting engine
Going from one person generating ten leads a day to having a machine behind the team producing 5,000 leads per per month was insane.
Almost immediately, the team noticed a dramatic improvement in data quality, which translated into better first conversations and higher engagement from the very first touch.
Since implementing Enginy, Factorial has seen a measurable improvements:
benefiting from centralized prospecting
Beyond better leads, Enginy allowed Factorial to go further with multichannel outreach and conditional campaigns.
Being able to say "if this prospect does X, then do Y" that’s where the real results come from.
‍This approach enabled the team to engage companies Factorial had never been able to reach before, opening entirely new opportunities without increasing headcount.
According to the team, that growth simply wouldn’t have been possible with manual prospecting.
If a company is thinking about Enginy, they should ask themselves one thing: do you want to double your sales productivity?

Enginy combines up-to-date professional profiles with company signals (funding, hiring, tech stack, location). It then finds verified emails and phone numbers through waterfall enrichment across 30+ data providers.
